description: [1^4] value leg: exact Lambda^A(C^4) antisymmetrizer rank = C(4,A) (He4-locality, A=4 unique rank-1 singlet) + exchange spectrum {+-sqrt5,+-1} closed-form det=(1-5m^2)(1-m^2) with attractive negative eigenvalue and physicality ceiling = writhe cap 1/sqrt5. Derives locality/sign/ceiling; the magnitude scalar (the Delta_lambda gate) stays open. No fit, audit-only.

part1_locality.verdict: DERIVED (exact, q-independent): the 4-body [1^4] channel is He4-LOCAL (C(4,A)=0 for A>4; A=5 first vanishing) and He4 (A=4) is the unique rank-1 fully-antisymmetric singlet -- the Wigner-supermultiplet closed shell.

part2_exchange_sign_and_ceiling.verdict: DERIVED (parameter-free, no fit): a negative eigenvalue (-sqrt5*mag) is always present so the dictionary's net-attractive branch (s=-1, B=-ln det(I+G)) is realized for any magnitude; det<1 => binding; and PHYSICALITY det>0 requires mag<1/sqrt5, EXACTLY the derived writhe cap. Naive z=0.4993 is excluded (det<0); reeb g=0.4467 sits just below the ceiling.

what_is_derived: attractive sign / -ln det branch (negative eigenvalue always present)
residual_open_scalar.what_is_NOT_derived: the per-pair magnitude selection inside (0, 1/sqrt5) and the E0->MeV dressing -- i.e. the b4 MeV VALUE.
residual_open_scalar.identification: that magnitude selection IS the Delta_lambda / E_unit gate (reeb audit 2026-07-06 sec 2j: the A-flattened normalization = the Delta_lambda closure); six parameter-free ansatze have failed and a seventh fit-based ansatz is forbidden (AGENTS.md).
residual_open_scalar.classification: CONSTRAINED-NOT-CLOSED. The b4 form's locality + sign + ceiling are derived parameter-free; the remaining scalar (the bond magnitude, hence the MeV magnitude) is the standing Delta_lambda gate and is NOT wired.
